init_ray_master: init a Ray cluster on the master node with a specified port and expected worker count
init_ray_worker: connect a Ray worker node to the master cluster with retry logic and configurable delays
calculate_object_store_memory: calculate the optimal Ray object store memory based on available memory and shared memory limits
monitor_ray_cluster_health: monitor Ray cluster health by running periodic health-check commands and exit on failure
cleanup_ray: cleanup and shut down the Ray cluster on the current node gracefully
